note: IOU-Z2-1 closed predicate vocabulary (design 2026-11-15-z2-iou-1-4 section 3). Add a predicate only with a one-line meaning; use related_to when nothing fits.

predicates.is_a: the subject is an instance or kind of the object
predicates.part_of: the subject is a component or member of the object
predicates.located_in: the subject is situated in the object (a place)
predicates.owned_by: the subject belongs to the object
predicates.works_for: the subject is employed by or acts for the object
predicates.uses: the subject uses or runs on the object
predicates.produces: the subject makes or outputs the object
predicates.causes: the subject brings about the object
predicates.has_value: the subject measures or amounts to the object's value (with a unit when it has one)
predicates.has_status: the subject is in the state the object names
predicates.occurred_on: the subject happened on the object's date
predicates.decided: the subject chose or ruled the object
predicates.related_to: fallback: a relation none of the above names
